comparison.objective: Tighten and fit an already-threaded necktie against a collar form.
comparison.physical_skill: Coordinated pulling and fitting of a reduced deformable tie model.
comparison.success_condition: Knot and blades meet position, size, orientation, and released-hold requirements.
comparison.reason: This is deformable dressing adjustment rather than tool-mediated setting and locking of a mechanical motion stop.
